hoaxes.title: Gemini 4 Neon adds a cheaper 'haiku tier' that answers every question in 17 syllables
hoaxes.truth: Made up. Gemini 4 Neon launched with a 1 million token context at $3 per million input tokens and $15 output.

hoaxes.title: Disney's Netflix deal adds a shared Ice Age button to both companies' TV remotes
hoaxes.truth: Made up. Disney licensed all five Ice Age films to Netflix and plans to spend $26 billion on content in 2027.

hoaxes.title: Rockstar is mailing a paper map of GTA VI's state to everyone who played on launch day
hoaxes.truth: Made up. GTA VI launched with a 99 on Metacritic and drew nearly 8 million live viewers, StreamCharts says.

hoaxes.title: Apple's touchscreen MacBook Pro comes with a stylus that folds out into a laptop stand
hoaxes.truth: Made up. Apple's first touchscreen MacBook Pro has a ProLED XDR OLED display and is listed from $2,899.
